title: QUIC RFC 9000 Disable Active Migration Preferred Address Exception Verification
verification_method: Focused S18P2 0016-0018 requirement-home tests, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, Release build, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers disable_active_migration transport-parameter encoding, parser rejection for non-empty values, runtime transport-flag commit, ordinary migration blocking, and preferred_address promotion after validation despite disable_active_migration.
expected_result: The focused tests show that disable_active_migration is encoded as an empty transport parameter, non-empty values are rejected, committed peer transport parameters set the runtime disable-active-migration flag, validated non-preferred migration candidates do not promote, preferred_address candidates do not promote before validation, and validated dedicated or port-only preferred_address candidates promote even when disable_active_migration is set.
procedure: Run the focused S18P2 0016-0018 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The transport-parameter codec accepts RFC 9000 Section 18.2 transport-parameter tuples.
The runtime has an active path representing the handshake address.
Peer transport parameters can be committed through the runtime TLS-state update path.
Preferred-address candidate paths can be path-validated through the existing path-validation event seam.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim max_ack_delay policy, initial data-limit parameters, preferred_address field-shape closure beyond the disable_active_migration exception, public migration APIs, multipath behavior, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S18P2 0016-0018 requirement-home filter passed 8/8, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0016 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0018 trace_clean, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 430 artifacts, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and the full Release test suite passed 4428/4428.
